title: Invariant-kernel transport through a measurable equivalence
source_anchor: Source-neutral interface motivated by MCMC arXiv:2407.12751v1 section 2.1.1, printed p.48 / PDF p.54, and Discrete Sampling arXiv:2307.13826v4 section 1.3, PDF p.5. Exact proof source is pinned Mathlib measure/kernel algebra, not a numbered textbook theorem.
target_statement: For arbitrary measurable spaces alpha and beta, arbitrary kernel kappa : Kernel alpha alpha and measure mu, and measurable equivalence e : alpha equiv beta, kappa.Invariant mu implies ((kappa.comap e.symm e.symm.measurable).map e).Invariant (mu.map e). No Markov, finite, s-finite, Standard Borel or nonempty hypotheses.

mcmc_contract.state_space: Arbitrary measurable alpha and beta linked by a measurable equivalence; tests split a dependent Fin (n+1) product.
mcmc_contract.target: Arbitrary invariant measure mu and its genuine pushforward mu.map e; zero, infinite and non-s-finite measures are permitted.
mcmc_contract.support: No density or support restrictions; no conditional-support claim on null fibers.
mcmc_contract.operator: Conjugate a kernel by comap with e.symm then map with e; action is on laws.
mcmc_contract.clock: One transported transition corresponds to one original transition. No continuous clock or sweep conversion.
mcmc_contract.invariance: Exact invariance transported between equivalent measurable state presentations.
mcmc_contract.ergodicity: Not assumed or concluded; no Markov hypothesis is needed by the generic transport statement.
mcmc_contract.initialization: Exact invariant initial law only; no other-start convergence.
mcmc_contract.metric: Exact measure equality, no discrepancy bound.
mcmc_contract.objective: Reusable invariance interface for coordinate heat-bath and fixed random-scan consumers.
mcmc_contract.source_proof_status: Source-neutral compiled algebra target, not source-theorem assimilation.
mcmc_contract.periodicity: No aperiodicity or gap claim; invariance alone is insufficient.

discrete_state_contract.state_space: Generic measurable spaces; finite configuration specialization is a downstream consumer, not a new finite-state definition.
discrete_state_contract.target: Any invariant measure; concrete Gibbs weights and normalization are downstream.
discrete_state_contract.operator: Measurable-equivalence conjugation of one transition kernel.
discrete_state_contract.clock: One update remains one update; no total-rate/per-site-rate interpretation.
discrete_state_contract.pinning: No conditioning-support or feasible-pinning theorem; heat-bath test keeps the selected conditional representative marginal-a.e.
discrete_state_contract.regime: Generic theorem only requires measurable spaces, measurable equivalence and existing invariance. Heat-bath tests add finite target and nonempty Standard Borel resampled coordinate.
discrete_state_contract.cost: No model-specific work or mixing bound.
discrete_state_contract.source_proof_status: Source-neutral algebra; section 1.3 copy-index issue is not interpreted or repaired.
discrete_state_contract.aperiodicity_or_absolute_gap: Not required for invariance; no convergence conclusion.
